# Alvi

Este gráfico está hecho con ploty, incluye los pesos del Alvi en las semanas siguientes de nacer.

```{r}
#| label: fig-peso-alvi
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Evolución del peso de Alvi"

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)

pesos <- tibble(
  fecha = dmy(c(
    "28-01-2026",
    "02-02-2026",
    "03-02-2026",
    "05-02-2026",
    "11-02-2026",
    "19-02-2026",
    "23-02-2026",
    "25-02-2026",
    "17-03-2026",
    "20-04-2026",
    "10-06-2026"
  )),
  peso_kg = c(
    3.465, 3.630, 3.630, 3.720, 4.010, 4.320,
    4.355, 4.455, 5.100, 6.010, 6.840
  ),
  talla_cm = c(
    NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
    58, NA, NA, 63, 67
  ),
  pc_cm = c(
    NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
    38, NA, NA, NA, NA
  )
)

pesos <- pesos %>%
  arrange(fecha) %>%
  mutate(
    dias_desde_inicio = as.numeric(fecha - first(fecha)),
    semanas = dias_desde_inicio / 7,
    dias_desde_anterior = as.numeric(fecha - lag(fecha)),
    ganancia_g = (peso_kg - lag(peso_kg)) * 1000,
    ganancia_g_dia = ganancia_g / dias_desde_anterior,
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>Fecha:</b> ", format(fecha, "%d-%m-%Y"), "<br>",
      "<b>Edad:</b> ", round(semanas, 1), " semanas<br>",
      "<b>Peso:</b> ", round(peso_kg, 3), " kg<br>",
      if_else(
        is.na(talla_cm),
        "",
        paste0("<b>Talla:</b> ", talla_cm, " cm<br>")
      ),
      if_else(
        is.na(pc_cm),
        "",
        paste0("<b>Perímetro cefálico:</b> ", pc_cm, " cm<br>")
      ),
      "<b>Ganancia desde control anterior:</b> ",
      if_else(is.na(ganancia_g), "—", paste0(round(ganancia_g), " g")),
      "<br>",
      "<b>Promedio diario:</b> ",
      if_else(is.na(ganancia_g_dia), "—", paste0(round(ganancia_g_dia, 1), " g/día"))
    )
  )

ultimo <- pesos %>% slice_tail(n = 1)

subtitulo <- paste0(
  "Último registro: ",
  round(ultimo$peso_kg, 2),
  " kg a las ",
  round(ultimo$semanas, 1),
  " semanas"
)

plot_ly(
  data = pesos,
  x = ~semanas,
  y = ~peso_kg,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  text = ~tooltip,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  line = list(
    width = 3,
    shape = "spline",
    smoothing = 0.65
  ),
  marker = list(
    size = 8,
    opacity = 0.9,
    line = list(width = 1.5)
  )
) %>%
  add_trace(
    data = ultimo,
    x = ~semanas,
    y = ~peso_kg,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text = ~paste0(round(peso_kg, 2), " kg"),
    textposition = "top center",
    hoverinfo = "skip",
    marker = list(
      size = 14,
      line = list(width = 2)
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "Evolución del peso",
        "<br><sup>", subtitulo, "</sup>"
      ),
      x = 0,
      xanchor = "left"
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Edad aproximada (semanas)",
      zeroline = FALSE,
      showgrid = TRUE,
      ticksuffix = " sem"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Peso (kg)",
      zeroline = FALSE,
      showgrid = TRUE,
      ticksuffix = " kg",
      range = c(
        floor(min(pesos$peso_kg) * 10) / 10 - 0.1,
        ceiling(max(pesos$peso_kg) * 10) / 10 + 0.3
      )
    ),
    hovermode = "closest",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 70, r = 30, t = 90, b = 70),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    hoverlabel = list(
      align = "left",
      bordercolor = "rgba(120,120,120,0.45)"
    )
  ) %>%
  config(
    displaylogo = FALSE,
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = c(
      "select2d",
      "lasso2d",
      "autoScale2d",
      "toggleSpikelines"
    )
  )
```
